definitions.gloss: to receive (honorific); to be granted; to be bestowed
definitions.explanation: A humble way of expressing receiving something from a social superior, or an honorific way of describing someone of high status giving something.

examples.japanese: ご{意見|いけん}を{賜|たまわ}りたい。
examples.english: I would like to receive your opinion.

examples.japanese: {陛下|へいか}よりお{言葉|ことば}を{賜|たまわ}った。
examples.english: We received words from His Majesty.

examples.japanese: ご{指導|しどう}を{賜|たまわ}りますようお{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

CONJUGATION:
・{賜|たまわ}らない (negative)
・{賜|たまわ}って (te-form)
・{賜|たまわ}った (past)

REGISTER:
Very formal/honorific. Used in business correspondence, formal speeches, and when addressing royalty or high-status individuals.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ご{意見|いけん}を{賜|たまわ}る - to receive your opinion
・ご{指導|しどう}を{賜|たまわ}る - to receive guidance
・お{時間|じかん}を{賜|たまわ}る - to receive your time

RELATED KEIGO:
・{賜|たま}う - archaic form (used in classical Japanese)
・{頂|いただ}く - less formal humble form of receiving
